'''Beshgrun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] who became a member of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-aligned cell that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Beshgrun became involved in plot by the cell to destroy a Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] that was docked with the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[New Dawn (space station)|''New Dawn'']] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Druckenwell. To carry out the attack, Beshgrun and a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] commanded by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] [[Denma]] and [[Tazzik]] planned to fly to ''New Dawn'' aboard the stolen [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[First Light (freighter)|''First Light'']], then take control of the assault ship and record a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] of the vessel's destruction, to broadcast to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, when Beshgrun and the rest of the pirates departed from Druckenwell in the ''First Light'' to initiate their raid, a team of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] stowed away aboard the ship. The agents then attacked Beshgrun and the rest of the crew, preventing them from destroying the ''Acclamator'' assault ship.
